scripts.test:ts: bun run build:gallery && bun --conditions=browser test --path-ignore-patterns=OLD_API packages/host/tests/*.test.ts packages/host/tests/*.test.mjs packages/react/tests/*.test.ts packages/react/tests/*.test.tsx packages/solid/tests/*.test.ts packages/solid/tests/*.test.tsx packages/i18n/tests/*.test.ts packages/widgets/tests/*.test.ts apps/gallery/tests/*.test.ts && node --test apps/gallery/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.generate:jsx: bun packages/solid/scripts/generate-jsx.mjs && bun packages/react/scripts/generate-jsx.mjs && node scripts/sync-cli-sdk.mjs
scripts.build:gallery: bun run generate:assets && ARGUI_GALLERY_ENTRY=core vite build --config apps/gallery/vite.config.ts && ARGUI_GALLERY_ENTRY=react vite build --config apps/gallery/vite.config.ts
